title: Atlassian - Data residency migrations halted.
text:
Service: Atlassian
Incident: Data residency migrations halted.
Status: resolved
Impact: minor
Started: 2024-08-20T11:46:28.000Z
Resolved: 2024-08-23T11:15:08.487Z
Updates:
- 2024-08-23T11:15:08.487Z: resolved - The issue with scheduling App data residency migrations has been resolved and the service is operating normally.
- 2024-08-20T11:46:28.463Z: investigating - Data residency migrations are currently not possible for Cloud customers. If you attempt a Data residency migration, you will encounter an error message, “We are unable to schedule your move” when you get to the “Review and submit your request” page.
An update will be shared here as soon as this service is resumed.

incident_updates.body: The issue with scheduling App data residency migrations has been resolved and the service is operating normally.

Data residency migrations are currently not possible for Cloud customers. If you attempt a Data residency migration, you will encounter an error message, “We are unable to schedule your move” when you get to the “Review and submit your request” page.
An update will be shared here as soon as this service is resumed.
